events.verdict: Ball (CLE) maintains a legal guarding position alongside McCollum's (WAS) path as he defends the drive and shot attempt.
McCollum (WAS) legally contests Mitchell's (CLE) jump shot attempt.
Wade (CLE) legally contests Carrington's (WAS) jump shot attempt.
Bagley III (WAS) and Mitchell (CLE) both pursue the rebound and the contact is incidental.
Mobley (CLE) jumps vertically and absorbs the contact that occurs during Bagley III's (WAS) shot attempt at the basket.
Mobley (CLE) legally contests Bagley III's (WAS) putback shot attempt.
Bagley III (WAS) is not established in a legal guarding position in Mitchell's (CLE) path and the ensuing body contact during Mitchell's driving shot attempt is more than marginal.
Bagley III (WAS) momentarily engages with Ball (CLE) during the screen.
Ball (CLE) legally contests McCollum's (WAS) jump shot attempt.
George (WAS) maintains a legal guarding position alongside Mitchell's (CLE) path as he defends the shot attempt.
Mitchell (CLE) gets his hand firmly on the ball to tie up Bagley III (WAS) and any contact during the play is incidental.
After initially making contact with the ball, McCollum (WAS) initiates contact with Ball's (CLE) arm that affects his ability to regain control of the loose ball.
Johnson (WAS) commits a take foul on Mobley (CLE).
Garland (CLE) directly contests Carrington's (WAS) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Carrington's left hand after the release.
Bagley III (WAS) rests his hand on Mobley's (CLE) shoulder during the pursuit of the rebound, and the contact is marginal.
Bagley III (WAS) rests his arm on Mobley's (CLE) shoulder during the pursuit of the rebound, and the contact is marginal.
McCollum (WAS) grabs and pulls Ball's (CLE) jersey in transition.
